methodFirst: Method is the true first move — before any link of the chain is laid, the KEY (Miller's interpretive rule) must already be in hand, because every link is forged by it. Miller's rule: "lay aside all preconceived opinions," dispense with commentaries, and "compare scripture with scripture" letting the Bible define its own figures, especially the year-for-a-day rule (Num 14:34; Ezek 4:6) that converts prophetic "days" into literal years (GC 320.1; MWV1 53.2-3; TSAM 65.3). Without this key the 2300 "days" stay six literal years and no chain exists; with it, the figures unlock. Brother Miller's Dream encodes exactly this priority: the casket = the advent truths, but the KEY ATTACHED = "his manner of interpreting the prophetic Word — Comparing scripture with scripture — the Bible its own interpreter," and only "with this key" does Miller open the casket and find the jewels "beautifully arranged in their several places" (BMD 3.3). So the order is: KEY first, then the arranged jewels (the doctrines in dependency order). The chain is not the first thing; the method that generates and orders it is.

startingPoint.answer: DOCTRINALLY the chain is MOTIVATED by the Second Advent (the terminus/goal that makes everything matter) and STRUCTURED on the spine of Daniel 2/7/8 (the one-prophecy frame); but it is COMPUTATIONALLY STARTED at the 70 weeks of Daniel 9 — specifically the 457 BC decree to Ezra — because that is the ONLY datable anchor. The 2300 days of Dan 8:14 is the longest prophetic line and the real subject, but it floats: it has no fixed beginning until the 70 weeks (cut off from the same vision) hand it a calendar date. So the chain BEGINS to be reckoned at 457 BC.
startingPoint.rationale: Miller states the dependency explicitly: 'But one thing still remains to be proved. When did the 2300 years begin?' He rules out Nebuchadnezzar's dream (→1697) and Gabriel's first visit (→1762), then: 'Let us begin it where the angel told us, from the going forth of the decree ... 457 years before Christ; take 457 from 2300, and it will leave A.D. 1843' (MWV2 54.2). The 70 weeks exist to supply this: Gabriel 'gave him a clue to know when his vision of the ram and he-goat began' (MWV1 46.2). The carriers make it a formal rule: 'when the date of the seventy weeks is established, the key to unlock and understand the reckoning of the days is in our hand' (S23D 19.2); 'When we ascertain the date of the seventy weeks, we have also ascertained the point from which the twenty-three hundred days are to be reckoned' (SOTB 4.1). EGW confirms the logic: 'If, then, the correct starting point could be found for the 2300 days, he concluded that the time of the second advent could be readily ascertained' (GC 324.3) — and that starting point is what Dan 9 alone provides. Note Miller's own ORDER OF DISCOVERY differs: he hit the 'seven times' (2520) first, THEN the 2300 days as confirmation (TSAM 65.3) — but in the finished LOGICAL chain the 70 weeks/457 BC is the load-bearing anchor.

chainLinks.link: THE KEY (method, not yet a doctrine): lay aside preconceptions, dispense with commentaries, compare scripture with scripture, let the Bible define its own figures — including year-for-a-day (Num 14:34; Ezek 4:6).
chainLinks.why: First because it forges every later link. The casket of advent truths can only be opened 'with this key'; the jewels are arranged in order only after the key turns. Year-for-a-day is the specific sub-rule that turns prophetic 'days' into literal years, without which 2300 days = 6 years and the whole chain collapses.

chainLinks.link: TERMINUS / MOTIVE: the literal, personal, premillennial Second Advent of Christ — the world is NOT converting; Christ comes bodily, in glory, to end this state (rejecting the spiritual-millennium view).
chainLinks.why: This is the GOAL the whole chain exists to date. It is laid early in the logical frame because it defines what all the prophetic periods are measuring TOWARD; everything downstream is an attempt to find WHEN this happens. It is a doctrinal terminus, not a datable anchor — it cannot start the computation, only motivate it.

chainLinks.link: THE SPINE: Daniel 2, 7, and 8 are ONE prophecy ('the dreams are the same') — the same succession of four kingdoms (Babylon, Persia, Grecia, Rome) destroyed by the stone/kingdom of God. The little horn of Dan 8 is therefore Rome, not Antiochus.
chainLinks.why: Comes after the goal because it is the structural backbone that lets one vision interpret another. By proving the three visions are one prophecy, Miller can legitimately carry the 70-weeks date (given in the Dan 9 sequel) back onto the 2300-day vision of Dan 8. Without this unity the cross-linking in links 5-6 is illegitimate.

chainLinks.link: THE LONGEST LINE: Daniel 8:14 — 'Unto 2300 days, then shall the sanctuary be cleansed.' By year-for-a-day, 2300 literal years; this is the answer to 'how long shall the vision be?' and the master period reaching to the Advent.
chainLinks.why: Laid before its own anchor because it is the SUBJECT being dated — the longest prophetic line, the thing the chain is really about. But it is deliberately incomplete here: Miller shows it cannot start at Nebuchadnezzar's dream (→1697) or Gabriel's visit (→1762). It hangs unanchored until link 5 supplies its beginning.

chainLinks.link: THE CUT-OFF / KEY-DATE: the 70 weeks (Dan 9:24-27) are 'determined' (cut off) from the 2300 days, dated from the decree to restore and build Jerusalem — the commandment to Ezra, 457 BC (Ezra 7) — running 490 years to seal/confirm the vision, fulfilled to A.D. 33 at the cross.
chainLinks.why: This is the LOAD-BEARING anchor — the only datable point in the whole chain. It is given by Gabriel precisely 'to show the beginning of the vision.' Because the 70 weeks are part of the same vision (link 3) and have a fixed historical start (457 BC), they hand the floating 2300-day line a calendar origin. 'When the date of the seventy weeks is established, the key ... is in our hand.'

chainLinks.link: THE COMPUTATION → 1843/44: 457 BC subtracted from 2300 = A.D. 1843 (or: 490 yrs to the cross A.D. 33, +1810 remaining = 1843). The terminus of the 2300 days.
chainLinks.why: Strictly derivative — it is pure arithmetic once link 5 supplies 457 BC and link 4 supplies 2300. It depends on BOTH the longest line (the number) and the anchor (the start). This is where the spine, the longest line, and the cut-off lock together: '457 BC proves 1843.'

chainLinks.link: THE EVENT AT THE TERMINUS: the cleansing of the sanctuary (Dan 8:14). Miller took the earth as the sanctuary, so the cleansing = the purification of the earth by fire at the Second Advent — closing the loop back to link 2.
chainLinks.why: Sits last because it identifies WHAT happens at the date computed in link 6, joining the dated terminus back to the motivating goal (the Advent). For Miller this was the Advent itself; the later pioneers re-identified the sanctuary as the heavenly one (a correction that does not change the chain's order, only the event named at the terminus).

chainLinks.link: CONVERGING WITNESSES (not the spine): the 'seven times' / 2520 years (Lev 26; reckoned from 677 BC to 1843) and the 'six thousand years' of earth's week — independent lines arriving at the same 1843.
chainLinks.why: Placed last and OFF the main spine because they are corroborative, not load-bearing: they terminate at the same date but neither anchors the 2300 days. Note: in Miller's personal discovery the 'seven times' came FIRST and led him to the 2300 days — but in the logical chain they function as confirming witnesses converging on the result already fixed by the 70-weeks anchor.

keyQuotes.quote: But one thing still remains to be proved. When did the 2300 years begin? Did it begin with Nebuchadnezzar's dream? No... did it begin when the angel Gabriel came to instruct Daniel into the 70 weeks? No... Let us begin it where the angel told us, from the going forth of the decree to build the walls of Jerusalem in troublous times, 457 years before Christ; take 457 from 2300, and it will leave A. D. 1843.

Then he gives him the 70 weeks, and tells him plainly that the 70 weeks would seal (or make sure) the vision and prophecy. Here he gave him a clue to know when his vision of the ram and he-goat began... If, then, the 70 weeks were a part of the vision of the ram and he-goat, and given... for the express purpose of showing the beginning of the vision, it remains a simple problem.

We have seen that the seventy weeks are cut off from the 2300 days. Hence, when the date of the seventy weeks is established, the key to unlock and understand the reckoning of the days is in our hand.

This shorter period being cut off from that long period gives us the key to the reckoning of that period from which it is cut off. When we ascertain the date of the seventy weeks, we have also ascertained the point from which the twenty-three hundred days are to be reckoned.

Following his rule of making Scripture its own interpreter, Miller learned that a day in symbolic prophecy represents a year... If, then, the correct starting point could be found for the 2300 days, he concluded that the time of the second advent could be readily ascertained.

To the casket there was a key attached ["the key" was his manner of interpreting the prophetic Word - Comparing scripture with scripture - the Bible its own interpreter]. I immediately took the key and opened the casket, when... I found it filled with all sorts and sizes of jewels... beautifully arranged in their several places in the casket.

I began at Genesis, and read on slowly; and when I came to a text that I could not understand, I searched through the Bible to find out what it meant... I was satisfied that the seven times terminated in 1843. Then I came to the 2300 days; they brought me to the same conclusion.

the three visions, had at three several times, are but one prophecy: Nebuchadnezzar's dream, Daniel 2:26-45; also Daniel 7.; and then Daniel 8., the ram and he-goat. My argument was, that these three visions are but one prophecy. "The dreams are the same"... And if this be true, then the little horn, instead of being Antiochus, must be the Roman kingdom.

Seventy weeks, then, or 490 days of the 2300, were cut off upon, or allotted to, Jerusalem and the Jews... if these seventy weeks are fulfilled as weeks of years, then the 2300 days, of which these are a part, are so many years. Thus the events of the seventy weeks furnish a key to the whole vision.

Here, then, we find the fulfilment of what the angel told Daniel would be done under the command that would begin the seventy weeks, and which is the same thing—"the vision." This decree was given 457 years before Christ: the seventy weeks began.

uncertainties: Discovery-order vs logical-order tension: Miller's autobiographical account (TSAM 65.3) has him reaching 1843 via the 'seven times'/2520 FIRST, with the 2300 days as confirmation — yet in his finished argument (MWV1, MWV2) and in every pioneer carrier the 70-weeks/457 BC is the load-bearing anchor and the 'seven times' is demoted to a converging witness. The 'first link' answer thus depends on whether one means how Miller HISTORICALLY started vs how the chain LOGICALLY starts. I have answered the logical-spine question (457 BC) per the task's framing, but the seven-times-first datum is a genuine wrinkle.

Whether Daniel 2 or Daniel 8 is 'the spine' is partly a framing choice: Dan 2 is the canonical backbone image (the metallic image/stone), but the DATABLE machinery lives in Dan 8 (2300 days) + Dan 9 (70 weeks). The handbook calls Dan 2 'the spine the whole canon walks'; Miller's computation never touches Dan 2's numbers. So 'spine' (structural) and 'anchor' (computational) are different roles I have kept distinct.

Miller's identification of the sanctuary as the EARTH (cleansed by fire at the Advent) is his own; the pioneers (Smith/DAR, Andrews) later corrected it to the HEAVENLY sanctuary. This changes the event named at link 7 but not the dependency order of the chain. Sources here are Miller-primary for his view and DAR for the correction; I did not fully trace the transition in LJHCS/MWV3 due to scope.

Exact 1843-vs-1844 reckoning (the spring-1844 vs autumn-1844 'tarrying' correction, the BC/AD zero-year adjustment) is downstream of the chain's logic and only lightly sampled (GC 328.3, DAR 207.3); the precise arithmetic fix is not fully reconstructed here.

I could not use an --author flag on egw search (unsupported); pioneer-carrier selection was done by phrase search, so there may be additional carrier passages (e.g., in Litch/Fitch/Andrews) not surfaced.
